branch-0.title: Examine Dr. Helena Vance Alibi & Records
branch-0.hypothesisOrLead: Arthur slipped poison into the chamomile tea before Finch delivered it.
branch-0.discoveryNote: Subpoenaed records and physical scrutiny reveal an unverified 30-minute window in the stated alibi. Item #EV-2 contradicts their presence.
branch-0.deductionHint: Eliminates the claim of being in a different wing during the critical event window.

branch-1.title: Forensic Lab Analysis of Internal Door Deadbolt Alignment
branch-1.hypothesisOrLead: Dr. Vance rigged an airborne vaporization trap using the heating coil and ventilation timer before Sterling locked the doors.
branch-1.discoveryNote: Spectrometric testing on #EV-3 confirms intentional chemical or mechanical tampering prior to the room sealing.
branch-1.deductionHint: Proves the mechanism did not require direct human intervention at the moment of detonation or exposure.

branch-2.title: Audit Arthur Sterling Access & Actions
branch-2.hypothesisOrLead: An intruder entered through a secret glass panel, poisoned Sterling, and escaped.
branch-2.discoveryNote: Keyholder audit clears Arthur Sterling of direct tampering, but reveals unauthorized access to the maintenance vents.
branch-2.deductionHint: Directs attention away from direct physical entry and points to the automated ventilation channels.
